pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/engine-claude/tests/fake_cli.rs:260 Every test of the Claude engine runs against hand-written CLI envelopes that name no CLI version, and no lane runs the real CLI. A change in the real CLI's output (for example a renamed cost field) would leave the whole suite green.

techniques.evidence: crates/engine-claude/tests/fake_cli.rs:260 This is the hand-written fake the technique names as the weak option. It is not a recording, and there is no live certification lane. Searched engine-claude, scripts/smoke.ps1 and the justfile for any real-CLI lane and found none.

crates/engine-search/tests/recency.rs:163 Each search test deletes its own index directory at the end of its body, so cleanup is left to each test's diligence and a failing assertion leaks the directory. The same per-file unique_dir and cleanup is copied into facets.rs and entity_fields.rs. No harness-named reaper exists, unlike core's RAII TempStore.
crates/engine-claude/tests/fake_cli.rs:30 The ETXTBSY fork race is absorbed once in settle_exec, with its incident (failed on ubuntu, passed locally) kept attached.
crates/engine-search/tests/recency.rs:130 A fixed-sleep flake was replaced by an observation poll with a generous one-sided deadline, and the incident is recorded.
crates/engine-search/tests/recency.rs:10 The singleton resource (the exclusive writer lock) is named, and each test gets its own directory.
crates/engine-wasm/tests/plugins.rs:111 The ABI pin matches the attribute line exactly, then reads the signature for its name, so prose in comments cannot satisfy it.
crates/engine-wasm/tests/plugins.rs:12 The gate for a loadable artifact loads it rather than compiling it, plus an EXPECTED inventory of every plugins-src crate.
